user.title: Hydro One portal login
user.description: Downloads hourly electricity history automatically every 24 hours. Enter your Hydro One credentials here in your own Home Assistant. This uses the customer portal; it is an unofficial integration. Credentials are stored in Home Assistant's config entries and backups.

meter.title: Choose the electricity meter
meter.description: Initial history is imported once. Later downloads overlap the last 14 days to include delayed data and corrections.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Hydro One
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current credentials for the existing electricity account.

error.invalid_auth: Hydro One did not accept the login. Check the credentials and whether the portal requires additional verification.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hydro One portal. It may be under maintenance, or the portal response may have changed.
error.no_meters: No metered electricity accounts were returned.
error.wrong_account: These credentials do not provide access to the selected electricity meter.

abort.already_configured: This electricity meter is already configured.
